stories.title: Measles outbreak rages in Bangladesh
stories.summary: A measles outbreak in Bangladesh is suspected to have killed more than 500 and sickened up to 60,000. Bangladesh was getting measles under control until a new government upended vaccination efforts.

stories.title: A wildfire off the California coast threatened one of the world's rarest pines
stories.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Heather Schneider of the Santa Barbara Botanic Garden about the garden's efforts to conserve seeds of rare plants from Santa Rosa Island, where a wildfire just burned.

stories.title: Immigration detention center known as 'Alligator Alcatraz' may soon close
stories.summary: A detention center in the Florida Everglades dubbed "Alligator Alcatraz" has become too expensive to maintain and may soon close.

stories.title: Checking in with swing state voters on how gas prices are affecting them
stories.summary: The price of a gallon of gas is up well over a dollar from where it was a year ago and these swing voters are feeling it.

stories.title: A National Spelling Bee champion shares what it takes to win
stories.summary: The 2025 Scripps National Spelling Bee champ shares what it takes to spell it right in 2026.

stories.title: Visual impairments don't keep these birders out of the hobby
stories.summary: The phrase "bird watching" does not take in the full range of people who love searching for wild birds. We meet a few of the many visually impaired birders who use their ears.
